description: mtg-multi: Telegram MTProto proxy with FakeTLS and domain fronting, a fork of 9seconds/mtg for many users: named per-user secrets, traffic stats, quotas and expiry, a management API, hot reload and the sponsored-channel ad-tag. The MTProto engine of 3X-UI.
notes: Command: mtg-multi. Scoop Apps: 'mtg-multi' lists the commands and waits for a key.
example.config.toml in %USERPROFILE%\scoop\apps\mtg-multi\current is upstream's annotated sample: copy it
somewhere of your own (it is replaced on update), then 'mtg-multi run <your config.toml>'.
Set usage-state-file in the config to keep the quota counters across restarts.
gesu/3X-UI copies mtg-multi.exe into its bin folder as mtg-windows-amd64.exe each time it starts.

script: # mtg-multi.exe without arguments only prints an error, so the shortcut opens this micro-launcher instead.
':: mtg-multi: shows what the command does and lists its commands, then waits for a key.',
':: Written by the gesu Scoop bucket at install time.',
('ECHO mtg-multi ' + $version + ': Telegram MTProto proxy with FakeTLS, many users per instance.'),
'ECHO Run it from any console as mtg-multi.',
'ECHO   mtg-multi generate-secret --hex example.com   new secret fronted by example.com',
'ECHO   mtg-multi run config.toml                     starts the proxy; Ctrl+C stops it',
'ECHO   mtg-multi access config.toml                  tg:// and t.me links for the secrets',
'ECHO   mtg-multi simple-run 0.0.0.0:443 SECRET       one secret, no config file',
'ECHO Copy it elsewhere before editing: the app folder is replaced on update.',
